**Cancellation policy:** I don't have those details on hand, so let me get our events manager to confirm that for you — they'll email you today.

**Fall availability:** for October, I have 10/3, 10/10, and 10/17 (Sat) open, plus most weekdays. I don't have visibility into November yet — want me to have someone check that for you?
